visual.general_description: Two stacked polysomnography hypnogram plots with limb-movement event rows for patient 1: (A) before BP treatment and (B) after BP treatment.
visual.detailed_description: Figure 1 contains two framed plots, (A) "Patient 1, before BP treatment" and (B) "Patient 1, after BP treatment". Each has a stepped black sleep-stage trace over labels N ausgew, W, R, N1, N2, N3 with red marks at the R level, and two strips of limb-movement rows LM [1], PLM [1], LM [2], PLM [2] holding small purple tick marks, above an x axis labelled Time (h). Panel A shows sparse marks mostly in the later part of the record; panel B shows only a few scattered marks and none in the PLM [2] row.

panels.general_description: Sleep recording plot titled "Patient 1, before BP treatment": stepped sleep-stage trace above rows of limb-movement event marks.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (A) of Figure 1: the panel letter and the title "Patient 1, before BP treatment" are printed above a framed plot. The upper frame shows a black stepped line against the y-axis labels N ausgew, W, R, N1, N2 and N3 (top to bottom); the line stays at the W and N1 to N2 levels for much of the record with many short vertical excursions, drops to the N3 level in a few stretches, and has short red horizontal marks at the R level (one clearly visible near the right end). Below are two framed strips: rows LM [1] and PLM [1] in the first and LM [2] and PLM [2] in the second, holding small purple tick marks that are sparse, with a few isolated early ticks and most ticks grouped in the later part of the record. The x axis is labelled Time (h) with dotted vertical lines at 00:00, 02:00, 04:00 and 06:00.

visual.general_description: Two stacked polysomnography hypnogram plots with limb-movement event rows for patient 5: (A) before BP treatment and (B) after BP treatment.
visual.detailed_description: Figure 2 contains two framed plots, (A) "Patient 5, before BP treatment" and (B) "Patient 5, after BP treatment". Each has a stepped black sleep-stage trace over labels N ausgew, W, R, N1, N2, N3 with several red segments at the R level, and strips of limb-movement rows LM [1], PLM [1], LM [2], PLM [2] with purple marks, above an x axis labelled Time (h). In both panels the LM [2] and PLM [2] rows hold long dense runs of marks in the first half of the record, while the [1] rows hold only a few marks.

panels.general_description: Sleep recording plot titled "Patient 5, before BP treatment": stepped sleep-stage trace above rows of limb-movement event marks.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (A) of Figure 2: the panel letter and the title "Patient 5, before BP treatment" are printed above a framed plot. The stepped black stage trace against the labels N ausgew, W, R, N1, N2 and N3 descends to N3 early, has several red horizontal segments at the R level in the first half and some later, and shows vertical excursions toward W throughout, with a cluster of vertical lines near the right end. In the lower strips, the LM [2] and PLM [2] rows hold long dense runs of purple marks in the first half of the record, the LM [1] row holds a few short clusters of ticks, and the PLM [1] row has a single short mark. The x axis is labelled Time (h) with vertical grey lines at 00:00, 02:00, 04:00 and 06:00.
